item.title: LLOTH Release New Official Video ‘Black Throne’
item.description: The Ancient Legions rise once more. LLOTH presents the official video for “Black Throne”, taken from their acclaimed album Archees Legeones (Ancient Legions). Prepare to descend into a realm of darkness, war, and unyielding Hellenic black metal fury. A thunderous combination of blistering riffs, relentless drums, and soul-searing vocals, “Black Throne” captures the essence of LLOTH’s epic sonic vision. This visual journey, […]

item.title: Maltese BOUND TO PREVAIL Drop New Single for Upcoming Album Title-Track ‘Enthroned in Torment’
